notes.title: Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams available now!
notes.content:
Hello my friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423470/Suicide_Guy_The_Lost_Dreams/

notes.title: Halloween Update is here! (Update 1.16)
notes.content:
Hello my friends!

The new Halloween update (Version 1.16) is now available for Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus, check it out!
It includes the first part of the DLC (the first 3 new levels) and more!

Check out all the features!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972820/Suicide_Guy_Deluxe_Plus/

Includes:

- 3 new exclusive levels!
- new option mode for players with cerebral palsy to unlock the mouse cursor 
- Performance improvements
- graphics enhancements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350833/11326c8bcaf8b973f7132dc83caa89aaf6f626d0.png

Have fun!
Chubby Pixel

notes.title: Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus is out today!
notes.content:
Hello my friends!
The Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus new edition is available today on Steam!


get the game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972820/Suicide_Guy_Deluxe_Plus/


What does the new Deluxe Edition include?

- 3 new exclusive levels

- Cloud saves

- Performance improvements

- Graphics enhancements

- Highly polished physics interactions

- New languages support (Korean, Arabic, Dutch, Swedish and Norwegian)

- Options for completely customizable button mappings

- Exclusive levels will be added as a Free update for all players in the next months after the initial release, so stay tuned!


Players will be challenged with the most complex and original brain teasers.

The game includes mature content, in particular violence, alcohol abuse and self-harm.
Despite the title the game is NOT about suicide or depression.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350833/4b7c375d052928c35bf612d247122a86e4535a6e.gif
